title: TRIG: Trajectory-Rig Decoupled Metric Geometry Learning
summary: Vision-centric autonomous driving requires accurate metric geometry and ego-motion estimation from synchronized multi-camera observations. Recent visual geometry models show strong performance in pose estimation, depth prediction, and 3D reconstruction, but are not tailored to rigid multi-camera driving systems. They often encode camera poses as entangled representations, in which time-varying ego-motion and static camera-rig geometry are jointly modeled, limiting the utilization of vehicle-side geometric priors. We propose Trajectory-Rig Decoupled Metric Geometry Learning (TRIG), a geometry perception framework for autonomous driving. TRIG factorizes camera poses into ego-trajectory and camera-rig components, enabling separate modeling of ego-motion and static multi-camera topology. We introduce decoupled pose encoding and supervision, which separately constrain trajectory evolution and rig geometry for metric-consistent learning. Moreover, sparse Temporal--Spatial attention separates cross-camera interaction from temporal aggregation, reducing global attention cost while preserving geometric reasoning. Experiments on five autonomous driving benchmarks show that TRIG achieves state-of-the-art performance in pose estimation, metric depth prediction, and 3D reconstruction.
tldr: TRIG decouples ego-trajectory and camera-rig geometry for metric-consistent pose, depth, and 3D reconstruction in multi-camera autonomous driving.
tldr_zh: TRIG 将自车轨迹与相机几何结构解耦，实现多相机自动驾驶系统中度量一致的位姿、深度与三维重建。
summary_zh: 以视觉为中心的自动驾驶需要从同步多摄像头观测中获取精确的度量几何与自车运动估计。现有视觉几何模型在姿态估计、深度预测和三维重建方面表现强劲，但并未针对刚性多摄像头驾驶系统进行专门设计。这些模型通常将摄像头位姿编码为纠缠表示，其中时变的自车运动与静态的摄像头刚体几何被联合建模，从而限制了车辆侧几何先验的利用。我们提出了一种面向自动驾驶的轨迹-刚体解耦度量几何学习框架（TRIG）。TRIG将摄像头位姿分解为自车轨迹与摄像头刚体组件，使得自车运动与静态多摄像头拓扑结构能够分别建模。我们引入了解耦的位姿编码与监督机制，分别约束轨迹演化与刚体几何，以实现度量一致性学习。此外，稀疏时空注意力将跨摄像头交互与时序聚合分离，在保持几何推理能力的同时降低了全局注意力成本。在五个自动驾驶基准数据集上的实验表明，TRIG在姿态估计、度量深度预测和三维重建方面均达到了最先进的性能。

title: Image2Sim: Scaling Embodied Navigation via Generative Neural Simulator
summary: Embodied navigation aims to build agents that interpret multimodal goals, reason in 3D space, and reach target destinations reliably in the real world. However, progress remains constrained by the lack of scalable, high-fidelity, and physically grounded interactive environments. Although real-world scanned datasets offer visual realism, they are limited by scale. In contrast, synthetic simulators scale more easily but often exhibit large sim-to-real gaps. We introduce Image2Sim, a real-time neural simulation framework that constructs high-quality interactive environments from posed RGB-D image sequences. The central idea is to decouple 3D spatial anchoring from photorealistic observation synthesis. For scene construction, Image2Sim uses a feed-forward feature Gaussian model that lifts posed RGB-D observations into a 3D feature-Gaussian representation in a single pass. For rendering, we propose a Geometry-Aware One-Step Pixel Flow model that transforms sparse and noisy Gaussian projections into high-quality panoramic RGB-D observations. Image2Sim also serves as a fully automated embodied data engine that generates high-fidelity observations, executable actions, and diverse navigation instructions at scale. It converts large collections of videos and images into nearly 20K interactive scenes and synthesizes more than 10 million navigation training samples. Navigation models trained entirely in these neural environments achieve strong improvements on major benchmarks and transfer effectively to real-world zero-shot settings. These results suggest that scalable neural simulation can serve as a practical training substrate for embodied navigation at scale.
tldr: Image2Sim is a neural simulation framework that constructs interactive 3D environments from posed RGB-D images using a feed-forward Gaussian model and a geometry-aware pixel-flow renderer, enabling large-scale training of navigation models that transfer to the real world.
tldr_zh: Image2Sim是一个神经模拟框架，通过前馈高斯模型和几何感知像素流渲染器从带位姿的RGB-D图像构建交互式3D环境，实现大规模导航模型训练并迁移到真实世界。
summary_zh: 具身导航旨在构建能够理解多模态目标、在三维空间中进行推理、并在真实世界中可靠抵达目标地点的智能体。然而，该领域进展仍受限于缺乏可扩展、高保真且具备物理交互基础的环境。尽管真实场景扫描数据集提供了视觉真实性，但其规模有限。相比之下，合成模拟器更易于扩展，却常存在较大的虚拟到现实差异。我们提出Image2Sim，一种实时神经模拟框架，能从带有位姿的RGB-D图像序列构建高质量交互环境。其核心思想是将三维空间锚定与逼真观测合成相解耦。在场景构建方面，Image2Sim采用前馈特征高斯模型，单次前向传播即可将带位姿的RGB-D观测提升为三维特征-高斯表征。在渲染方面，我们提出几何感知单步像素流模型，将稀疏且含噪的高斯投影转化为高质量全景RGB-D观测。Image2Sim同时可作为全自动具身数据引擎，大规模生成高保真观测、可执行动作及多样化导航指令。它可将大量视频与图像集合转化为近2万个交互场景，并合成超过1000万个导航训练样本。完全在这些神经环境中训练的导航模型在主流基准测试中取得显著提升，并有效迁移至真实世界的零样本场景。这些结果表明，可扩展的神经模拟可成为大规模具身导航的实用训练基础。

title: Lift3D-VLA: Lifting VLA Models to 3D Geometry and Dynamics-Aware Manipulation
summary: Recently, Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong generalization across diverse tasks. However, effective robotic manipulation in physical environments fundamentally requires geometric understanding and spatial reasoning. While some VLA approaches attempt to incorporate 3D information, they are constrained by limited data availability and geometric information loss in current 3D encoding pipelines, and fail to jointly capture 3D geometry and temporally structured actions in dynamic environments. To address these limitations, we introduce Lift3D-VLA, a unified VLA framework that equips models with explicit 3D point cloud reasoning and enables temporally coherent action generation. First, building upon our previous work Lift3D, an enhanced 2D model-lifting strategy is proposed to geometrically align 3D points with pretrained 2D positional embeddings. This design enables direct point-cloud encoding within the VLA vision encoder while minimizing spatial information loss. Based on explicit 3D inputs, we propose Geometry-Centric Masked Autoencoding (GC-MAE), a dual-objective self-supervised framework that reconstructs the current point cloud while predicting its future geometric evolution. This formulation allows the 2D vision encoder to internalize both 3D structure and physical dynamics. To fully exploit 3D representations, we further design layer-wise temporal action modeling, which leverages multiple layers of the LLM to collaboratively predict action chunks, enabling temporally consistent predictions. Across 22 simulated tasks and 8 real-world manipulation tasks, Lift3D-VLA achieves 10.8% and 11.1% higher mean success rates on MetaWorld and RLBench than the best-performing prior VLA methods, and outperforms the strongest real-world baseline by 4 percentage points, while exhibiting stronger generalization to out-of-distribution perturbations.
tldr: Lift3D-VLA integrates 3D point cloud reasoning and a geometry-centric masked autoencoding objective into a VLA model, achieving improved manipulation success rates on simulated and real tasks.
tldr_zh: Lift3D-VLA 将3D点云推理和以几何为中心的掩码自编码目标集成到VLA模型中，在模拟和真实操作任务上取得了更高的成功率。
summary_zh: 最近，视觉-语言-动作模型在多样化任务中展现出强大的泛化能力。然而，物理环境中有效的机器人操作从根本上依赖于几何理解与空间推理。尽管部分视觉-语言-动作方法尝试融入三维信息，但受限于当前三维编码流水线中数据可用性不足与几何信息损失问题，且无法在动态环境中联合捕获三维几何结构与时序化动作。为克服这些局限，我们提出Lift3D-VLA——一个统一的视觉-语言-动作框架，使模型具备显式三维点云推理能力，并生成时序连贯的动作。首先，基于我们前期工作Lift3D，提出增强型二维模型升维策略，通过几何对齐将三维点与预训练二维位置嵌入相关联。该设计使得视觉编码器能够直接处理点云编码，同时最大程度减少空间信息损失。基于显式三维输入，我们提出几何中心掩码自编码，这是一个双目标自监督框架，在重建当前点云的同时预测其未来几何演化。该范式使二维视觉编码器能够内化三维结构与物理动力学。为充分利用三维表征，我们进一步设计逐层时序动作建模，利用大语言模型的多层结构协同预测动作片段，从而实现时序一致的预测。在22项模拟任务与8项真实世界操作任务中，Lift3D-VLA在MetaWorld和RLBench上的平均成功率分别比最优视觉-语言-动作方法高出10.8%和11.1%，且比最强真实世界基线提升4个百分点，同时在分布外扰动场景中展现出更强的泛化能力。

title: RynnWorld-4D: 4D Embodied World Models for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Robotic manipulation in the open world requires not only recognizing what a scene looks like, but also anticipating how its 3D structure moves under interaction. We argue that synchronized RGB, depth, and optical flow, namely RGB-DF, provide a physically grounded representation that captures the underlying 4D dynamics of a scene. Compared to 2D pixel videos, this multi-modal synergy aligns visual appearance with geometric structure and temporal motion, creating a representation space significantly closer to the low-level end-effector actions demanded by robotic systems, thereby narrowing the gap between world prediction and policy learning. Building on this insight, we introduce RynnWorld-4D, a generative model that co-produces future RGB frames, depth maps, and optical flow from a single RGB-D image and a language instruction within one unified diffusion process. This 4D world model features a tri-branch architecture that integrates cross-modal attention with frame-wise 3D RoPE, ensuring that appearance, geometry, and motion evolve consistently. To supply training data at scale, we curate Rynn4DDataset 1.0, a massive dataset of over 254.4 million frames across egocentric human and robotic manipulation videos with high-quality pseudo-labels for depth and optical flow. We further propose RynnWorld-4D-Policy, an inverse dynamics head that consumes the internal 4D representations of RynnWorld-4D in a single forward pass, bypassing expensive multi-step denoising, to output robot actions in a closed-loop manner. Experiments show that RynnWorld-4D produces temporally and spatially coherent 4D predictions, and that RynnWorld-4D-Policy achieves state-of-the-art performance on real-world dexterous bimanual manipulation tasks, particularly excelling in tasks demanding spatial precision and temporal coordination.
tldr: RynnWorld-4D introduces a 4D world model that co-generates future RGB, depth, and optical flow from a single RGB-D image and language instruction via a unified diffusion process, and an inverse dynamics head that directly consumes its internal 4D representations for closed-loop robotic manipulation. The model achieves state-of-the-art performance on real-world dexterous bimanual manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: RynnWorld-4D 提出了一种4D世界模型，通过统一的扩散过程从单张RGB-D图像和语言指令共同生成未来的RGB、深度和光流，并设计了直接利用其内部4D表征进行闭环机器人操作的反向动力学头。该模型在真实世界灵巧双臂操作任务上达到了最优性能。
summary_zh: 开放世界中的机器人操作不仅需要识别场景的外观，更需要预判其三维结构在交互作用下的动态变化。我们提出，同步的RGB图像、深度图与光流场（即RGB-DF）能够提供一种基于物理的表征，捕捉场景隐含的四维动态。与二维像素视频相比，这种多模态协同将视觉外观、几何结构与时序运动对齐，构建出显著接近机器人系统所需的低层级末端执行器动作的表征空间，从而缩小了世界预测与策略学习之间的差距。基于这一洞见，我们提出RynnWorld-4D——一个生成式模型，能够从单张RGB-D图像和语言指令出发，在统一的扩散过程中联合生成未来的RGB帧、深度图和光流场。该四维世界模型采用三分支架构，融合跨模态注意力机制与逐帧三维旋转位置编码，确保外观、几何与运动的一致性演化。为提供大规模训练数据，我们构建了Rynn4DDataset 1.0数据集——包含超过2.544亿帧第一人称视角人类与机器人操作视频，并配有高质量的深度图与光流伪标签。我们进一步提出RynnWorld-4D-Policy逆向动力学头，通过单次前向传播直接利用RynnWorld-4D的内部四维表征，绕过多步去噪的高昂计算代价，以闭环方式输出机器人动作。实验表明，RynnWorld-4D能够生成时空一致的四维预测，而RynnWorld-4D-Policy在真实世界灵巧双臂操作任务中达到了最先进的性能，尤其在需要空间精度与时间协调的任务中表现卓越。

title: RynnWorld-Teleop: An Action-Conditioned World Model for Digital Teleoperation
summary: Scaling robot learning requires massive, diverse trajectory data, yet collection is currently bottlenecked by physical teleoperation, where every demonstration binds operator time to specific hardware and workspaces. We introduce digital teleoperation, a paradigm that decouples data collection from physical constraints by replacing the real robot with a generative world model. In this framework, an operator's hand-pose stream drives a robot-centric generative world model to synthesize high-fidelity egocentric videos from a single reference image. The recorded pose stream serves as an embodiment-agnostic action label transferable to any target robot via standard retargeting, yielding complete state-action trajectories for imitation learning independent of physical hardware. We instantiate this paradigm in RynnWorld-Teleop, a system that integrates depth-aware skeletal conditioning, progressive human-to-robot training on a video Diffusion Transformer, and streaming autoregressive distillation. This pipeline compresses the generative process into a single-pass inference, enabling 40+ FPS, real-time interactive generation on a single H100 GPU. Policies trained exclusively on RynnWorld-Teleop-generated data achieve effective zero-shot Sim2Real transfer across dexterous and diverse bimanual tasks. Moreover, augmenting real-world datasets with our digitally teleoperated data consistently improves success rates, demonstrating that RynnWorld-Teleop serves as a high-fidelity, scalable data engine for the next generation of robotic agents.
tldr: This paper introduces digital teleoperation, a paradigm where an action-conditioned world model replaces physical robots to generate synthetic training data, enabling scalable data collection for imitation learning. The system, RynnWorld-Teleop, achieves real-time egocentric video generation and demonstrates zero-shot Sim2Real transfer for bimanual manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种数字遥操作范式，利用动作条件世界模型替代物理机器人生成合成训练数据，从而实现可扩展的模仿学习数据收集。RynnWorld-Teleop 系统实现了实时第一视角视频生成，并在双臂操作任务中展示了零样本 Sim2Real 迁移能力。
summary_zh: 拓展机器人学习需要海量、多样化的轨迹数据，但目前的数据采集受限于物理遥操作——每次演示都需要操作员花费时间绑定特定硬件和工作空间。我们提出数字遥操作范式，通过用生成式世界模型替代真实机器人，将数据收集从物理约束中解放出来。在该框架中，操作员的手部姿态流驱动以机器人为中心的生成式世界模型，从单张参考图像合成高保真第一人称视频。记录的姿态流作为与具体实体无关的动作标签，可通过标准重定向迁移至任意目标机器人，从而获得与物理硬件无关的完整状态-动作轨迹，用于模仿学习。我们通过RynnWorld-Teleop系统实例化该范式，该系统集成了深度感知骨骼条件约束、基于视频扩散Transformer的渐进式人机协同训练，以及流式自回归蒸馏技术。该流程将生成过程压缩为单次推理，可在单张H100 GPU上实现40 FPS以上的实时交互式生成。仅基于RynnWorld-Teleop生成数据训练的模型，在灵巧且多样化的双臂任务中实现了零样本Sim2Real迁移。此外，用数字遥操作数据增强真实世界数据集后，任务成功率持续提升，证明RynnWorld-Teleop能够为下一代机器人智能体提供高保真、可扩展的数据引擎。

title: Pelican-VLA 0.5: Attending Before Acting Benefits Generalization
summary: In this report, we present Pelican-VLA 0.5, a unified VLA model that integrates vision-language understanding, future-frame generation, and action prediction within a single architecture. Pelican-VLA 0.5 achieves attention-level generalization: without object annotations, segmentation masks, attention supervision, or task-specific fine-tuning, its action pathway already focuses on the instruction-relevant object and contact region. This behavior persists across unseen scenes and unseen robot embodiments, and is substantially stronger than in other open-source VLA baselines. We verify that this ability originates from the learnable Reasoning Slots inserted between perception and action: by routing task-relevant visual information through a compact bottleneck, the slot interface induces manipulation-centric attention during pre-training and remains effective across different policy structures, including a MoT-style architecture.
tldr: Pelican-VLA 0.5 introduces a unified VLA model with learnable Reasoning Slots that enhance attention-level generalization to unseen scenes and robot embodiments without task-specific fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: Pelican-VLA 0.5 提出了一种统一的 VLA 模型，通过可学习的推理槽位增强注意力级别的泛化能力，无需任务特定微调即可泛化到未见场景和机器人本体。
summary_zh: 本报告介绍了Pelican-VLA 0.5——一种统一视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，它在单一架构中集成了视觉语言理解、未来帧生成与动作预测功能。Pelican-VLA 0.5实现了注意力层级泛化：无需目标标注、分割掩码、注意力监督或任务特定微调，其动作通路已能聚焦于指令相关目标及接触区域。该行为在未见场景与未知机器人形态中均保持一致，且显著优于其他开源VLA基线模型。我们验证了该能力源自感知与动作之间插入的可学习推理槽：通过紧凑瓶颈传递任务相关视觉信息，该槽接口在预训练阶段诱导出以操作为中心的注意力模式，并在包括MoT风格架构在内的不同策略结构中持续有效。

title: UniLM-Nav: A Unified Framework for Zero-Shot Last-Mile Navigation
summary: Mobile manipulation requires a robot to navigate to a target object or receptacle and then perform intended manipulation. However, reaching the vicinity of the target does not guarantee a manipulation-ready base pose, a problem known as last-mile navigation. Prior methods for last-mile navigation either rely on manual pose annotation or task-specific training, limiting their scalability to open-vocabulary settings with fine-grained spatial constraints. We propose UniLM-Nav, a unified framework for zero-shot open-vocabulary last-mile navigation. UniLM-Nav decomposes last-mile navigation into view selection, task-conditioned affordance grounding, and geometry-aware base-pose reasoning, all resolved with a shared multimodal large language model (MLLM) backend. Specifically, UniLM-Nav first selects a reference view that best captures the target object or receptacle from recently collected observations. It then grounds task-relevant affordance point in the selected view and lifts the result into the robot-centric coordinate frame. Finally, conditioned on the grounded affordance, task context, and robot geometry, it infers a manipulation-ready base pose for the robot. We evaluate UniLM-Nav on the OVMM benchmark, where it outperforms the previous state-of-the-art method, MoTo, by 3.13 percentage points. Analyses show that the components of our method are crucial to final performance, and that the choice of MLLM also has a substantial effect. We further deploy UniLM-Nav on a Unitree B2 quadruped robot with a 6-DoF Unitree Z1 manipulator, validating its applicability to real-world mobile manipulation tasks.
tldr: A zero-shot framework for last-mile navigation that uses a shared MLLM to select views, ground affordances, and infer manipulation-ready base poses, outperforming prior work on OVMM and validated on a real quadruped robot.
tldr_zh: 一种零样本的最后一公里导航框架，通过共享的MLLM进行视图选择、任务相关可操作性区域识别和操作就绪基座姿态推理，在OVMM上超越先前工作并在四足机器人上验证。
summary_zh: 移动操作要求机器人导航至目标物体或容器，随后执行预期操作。然而，仅到达目标附近并不能保证操作就绪的基座姿态，这一问题被称为“最后一公里导航”。现有最后一公里导航方法要么依赖人工位姿标注，要么需要针对特定任务进行训练，这限制了其在具有精细空间约束的开放词汇场景中的可扩展性。我们提出UniLM-Nav——一个面向零样本开放词汇最后一公里导航的统一框架。UniLM-Nav将最后一公里导航分解为视角选择、任务条件可操作性定位和几何感知基座姿态推理，所有子任务均由共享的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）后端完成。具体而言，UniLM-Nav首先从近期收集的观测数据中选取最能捕捉目标物体或容器的参考视角；随后在该视角中定位任务相关的可操作点，并将结果映射至机器人中心坐标系；最后，基于所定位的可操作点、任务上下文及机器人几何信息，推理出机器人可执行操作的基座姿态。我们在OVMM基准上评估UniLM-Nav，其性能较先前最先进方法MoTo提升3.13个百分点。分析表明，本方法各组件对最终性能至关重要，且MLLM的选择亦产生显著影响。我们进一步在配备六自由度Unitree Z1机械臂的Unitree B2四足机器人上部署UniLM-Nav，验证了其在真实世界移动操作任务中的适用性。

title: SIEVE: Structure-Aware Data Selection for Imitation Learning with VLA Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are typically trained by imitation learning on large-scale robot demonstration datasets, but more data does not necessarily yield better policies due to redundancy, noise, and uneven coverage. Existing data selection methods often assess demonstrations at either the trajectory or state-action level, missing the reusable structures that compose long-horizon behaviors. In this paper, we propose SIEVE, a structure-aware data selection method for VLA imitation learning. SIEVE views demonstrations as compositions of reusable primitives and transition interfaces. It first discovers visuo-motor primitives from segmented trajectories, then allocates selection budgets to composition patterns by maximizing reuse-aware structural exposure under diminishing returns. Finally, it selects medoid trajectories within each composition-pattern bucket to retain central, stable, and imitation-friendly demonstrations. Experiments across multiple datasets, benchmarks, and VLA models show that SIEVE consistently outperforms competitive data selection baselines. Notably, SIEVE can surpass full-data training while using only 50% of demonstrations and 50% of training steps, suggesting that reusable structure, captured through primitives and transitions, is an important signal for efficient VLA imitation learning.
tldr: SIEVE proposes a structure-aware data selection method for VLA imitation learning that discovers reusable visuo-motor primitives and transitions from demonstrations, enabling effective policy learning with fewer data and training steps.
tldr_zh: SIEVE提出了一种面向VLA模仿学习的结构感知数据选择方法，通过发现演示中的可重用视觉运动原语和过渡结构，实现用更少的数据和训练步骤学习有效策略。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通常通过在大规模机器人演示数据集上的模仿学习进行训练，但由于数据存在冗余、噪声以及覆盖不均等问题，更多的数据并不必然带来更优的策略。现有数据选择方法通常仅在轨迹级别或状态-动作级别评估演示，忽略了构成长期行为中可复用的结构。本文提出SIEVE，一种面向VLA模仿学习的结构感知数据选择方法。SIEVE将演示视为可复用基元与过渡接口的组合。它首先从分割后的轨迹中发现视觉运动基元，随后通过基于递减回报下复用感知的结构暴露度最大化，为不同的组合模式分配选择预算。最后，在每个组合模式分组中选取质心轨迹，以保留中心化、稳定且利于模仿的演示。在多个数据集、基准测试及VLA模型上的实验表明，SIEVE始终优于具有竞争力的数据选择基线方法。值得注意的是，SIEVE仅使用50%的演示数据和50%的训练步骤即可超越全数据训练效果，这表明通过基元与过渡捕获的可复用结构，是实现高效VLA模仿学习的重要信号。

title: WristMimic: Full-Body Humanoid Control with Wrist-Guided Manipulation
summary: Retargeting human object interaction demonstrations to physics based simulation requires reproducing not only body motion but also the object motion and contacts that make manipulation succeed. However, position only hand trajectories do not specify the contact forces needed to manipulate objects, and directly tracking them can overconstrain contact rich finger behavior. We introduce WristMimic, a wrist guided whole body control framework that explicitly separates contact free body motion from contact rich hand manipulation. The contact free body and wrist are guided by kinematic pose targets, whereas the fingers are not directly supervised by human hand pose. Instead, they learn grasping and manipulation behaviors from object tracking and contact outcomes. Our key insight is that the wrist is the natural gate between these two regimes. It is largely free from contact and can be tracked kinematically, yet it determines the global hand configuration and places the fingers within reachable grasp affordances. To ensure reliable wrist placement during interaction, we introduce wrist specific reset constraints and reward prioritization. Experiments show that WristMimic matches or surpasses methods using full finger pose supervision while enabling finger agnostic retargeting across diverse hand embodiments.
tldr: WristMimic introduces a wrist-guided whole-body control framework for humanoid robots that separates contact-free body motion from contact-rich hand manipulation, enabling robust retargeting of human demonstrations without direct finger pose supervision.
tldr_zh: WristMimic 提出了一种以手腕为导向的全身控制框架，将无接触的身体运动与富含接触的手部操作分离，无需直接的手指姿态监督即可实现鲁棒的人体演示重定向。
summary_zh: 将人-物交互演示迁移到基于物理的仿真中，不仅需要复现身体运动，还需复现使操作成功的物体运动与接触。然而，仅包含位置信息的手部轨迹无法指定操作物体所需的接触力，直接跟踪这些轨迹会过度约束手指丰富的接触行为。本文提出WristMimic，一种以手腕引导的全身控制框架，明确将无接触身体运动与富含接触的手部操作分离。无接触身体与手腕由运动学姿态目标引导，而手指不直接受人体手部姿态监督，转而通过物体跟踪与接触结果学习抓取与操作行为。我们的关键洞察在于：手腕是这两个机制间的天然枢纽——它基本不受接触约束且可进行运动学跟踪，但同时决定了全局手部构型，并将手指置于可达的抓取空间内。为确保交互过程中手腕位置的可靠性，我们引入手腕专用复位约束与奖励优先级机制。实验表明，WristMimic在匹配或超越全手指姿态监督方法性能的同时，实现了跨不同手部形态的、与手指无关的重定向能力。

title: From Foundation to Application: Improving VLA Models in Practice
summary: Despite recent progress of VLA foundation models, the disparity between laboratory conditions and real-world applications continues to impede their practical implementation. To bridge this gap, we present LingBot-VLA 2.0, which advances LingBot-VLA through improvements in three functional domains. (1) Generalization across tasks and embodiments. Compared to the previous version, we revamp the data processing pipeline and curate around 60,000 hours of data for pretraining, including 50,000 hours of robot trajectories spanning 20 robot configurations and 10,000 hours of egocentric human videos. (2) Expanded action space in addition to dual-arm hardware platforms. In particular, our system accommodates degrees of freedom for the heads, waists, mobile bases, and dexterous hands, thereby empowering the robots to tackle more complex tasks in practical scenarios. (3) Predictive dynamics modeling for improved temporal reasoning. Specifically, we formulate future prediction as a proxy task, facilitated by a video representation model for semantic priors and a depth estimation model for geometric cues. Evaluations on the GM-100 benchmark, conducted in a generalist setting, validate the beneficial impact of these proposed modifications. Furthermore, benefiting from the expanded pretraining data that covers whole-body degrees of freedom, LingBot-VLA-2.0 demonstrates strong cross-embodiment long-horizon mobile manipulation capability across the two robotic platforms.
tldr: This paper presents LingBot-VLA 2.0, an improved VLA foundation model for robotics that enhances generalization through larger, diverse pretraining data, expands action space to whole-body control, and introduces predictive dynamics modeling for temporal reasoning. Evaluations on the GM-100 benchmark and real-robot demonstrations validate these improvements.
tldr_zh: 本文提出 LingBot-VLA 2.0，一种改进的 VLA 基础模型，通过更大的多样化预训练数据提升泛化性，扩展动作空间到全身控制，并引入预测动力学建模增强时序推理。在 GM-100 基准和真实机器人上的实验验证了这些改进的有效性。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
尽管VLA基础模型近期取得了进展，但实验室条件与实际应用之间的差异仍阻碍其落地实践。为弥合这一鸿沟，我们提出LingBot-VLA 2.0，该模型通过三个功能域的改进对LingBot-VLA进行了升级。（1）跨任务与跨形态的泛化能力。相较于前代版本，我们重构了数据处理流程，并整理了约6万小时数据用于预训练，其中包括涵盖20种机器人构型的5万小时机器人轨迹数据，以及1万小时第一人称人类视频数据。（2）在双臂硬件平台基础上扩展动作空间。具体而言，本系统可兼容头部、腰部、移动底座及灵巧手的自由度控制，从而使机器人能够应对实际场景中更复杂的任务。（3）面向时序推理能力提升的预测性动力学建模。为此，我们将未来状态预测设定为代理任务，并借助视频表征模型提取语义先验信息，同时结合深度估计模型获取几何线索。在通用型设置下基于GM-100基准的评估验证了上述改进的有效性。此外，得益于覆盖全身自由度的扩展预训练数据，LingBot-VLA-2.0在两个机器人平台上展现出强大的跨形态长时程移动操作能力。

title: Training-Free Acceleration for Vision-Language-Action Models with Action Caching and Refinement
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising approach for generalizable robotic manipulations. In particular, flow matching-based VLA models have shown remarkable success due to their capability to generate precise and smooth action sequences and capture multimodal distributions. However, the iterative denoising process in the action head acts as a major computational bottleneck, posing a critical challenge for real-time deployment. To address this challenge, we propose ActionCache, a plug-and-play external cache that opportunistically reuses past intermediate actions to warm-start generations from the vicinity of target actions, thereby drastically reducing the inference latency. Specifically, ActionCache stores the intermediate actions with compact multimodal keys, which enables retrieval from similar past contexts across different episodes or even different tasks. Experimental results in simulation and real-world environments demonstrate that ActionCache maintains high task success rates in a low-latency regime, achieving inference acceleration of up to $11.75\times$ and $34.43\times$ for representative flow-based VLA models, $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T-N1.6, respectively.
tldr: Proposes ActionCache, a plug-and-play cache that stores and reuses intermediate actions from flow-matching VLA models to drastically reduce inference latency while maintaining task success rates.
tldr_zh: 提出ActionCache，一种即插即用的缓存机制，通过存储和重用流匹配VLA模型中的中间动作来大幅降低推理延迟，同时保持任务成功率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为实现通用机器人操控的前沿方法。其中，基于流匹配的VLA模型因能生成精确平滑的动作序列并捕捉多模态分布而展现出显著优势。然而，动作头中的迭代去噪过程构成了主要计算瓶颈，对实时部署提出了严峻挑战。针对这一问题，我们提出ActionCache——一种即插即用的外部缓存机制，能策略性地复用过往的中间动作，从目标动作附近启动生成过程，从而大幅降低推理延迟。具体而言，ActionCache通过紧凑的多模态键存储中间动作，支持跨不同场景甚至不同任务从相似的过往上下文中进行检索。仿真与真实环境实验结果表明，ActionCache能在低延迟条件下保持高任务成功率：对于代表性基于流的VLA模型π₀.₅和GR00T-N1.6，其推理加速比分别达到11.75倍和34.43倍。

title: Driving the Wrong Way: Leveraging Interpretability in End2End Autonomous Driving Models
summary: The increasing adoption of end-to-end learning for autonomous driving introduces increased model complexity and opacity, raising the risk of learning undesired or erroneous behavior. In this work, we integrate unsupervised dictionary learning as a post hoc interpretability module within state-of-the-art driving models to decompose driving behavior into semantically meaningful concepts while demonstrating their causal influence on the model's driving decisions. We propose a stepwise framework for extracting and interpreting meaningful concepts from the end-to-end model and connecting them to the multifaceted model outputs, thereby revealing the underlying decision-making logic for the prediction of future trajectories. Furthermore, targeted interventions at the concept level allow us to manipulate and correct driving decisions, resulting in measurable improvements in overall driving performance. We thus demonstrate how interpretability can effectively be used to reduce model opacity, uncover erroneous behavior, and enable targeted mitigation, ultimately boosting model performance.
tldr: This paper integrates unsupervised dictionary learning as a post-hoc interpretability module for end-to-end autonomous driving models, enabling concept-level manipulation and correction of driving decisions to improve performance.
tldr_zh: 该论文将无监督字典学习作为事后可解释性模块集成到端到端自动驾驶模型中，实现概念层面的操作和驾驶决策修正，从而提升性能。
summary_zh: 端到端学习在自动驾驶领域的日益普及带来了模型复杂度与不透明度的提升，增加了学习到不良或错误行为模式的风险。在本研究中，我们将无监督字典学习作为事后可解释性模块集成至当前最先进的驾驶模型，将驾驶行为分解为具有语义含义的概念，同时揭示这些概念对模型驾驶决策的因果影响。我们提出了一套分步框架，用于从端到端模型中提取并解释有意义的概念，并将其与多元化的模型输出相关联，从而揭示未来轨迹预测背后的决策逻辑。此外，通过概念层面的定向干预，我们能够操控并修正驾驶决策，最终使整体驾驶性能获得可量化的提升。本研究因此证明：可解释性能够有效降低模型不透明度、发现错误行为模式并实施定向修正，最终提升模型性能。

title: LAMP: Latent Motion Prior-Guided Real-World Learning for Dexterous Hand Manipulation
summary: Real-world learning for dexterous hands remains brittle because high-dimensional hand actions amplify imitation errors and make reinforcement-learning exploration prone to contact-breaking motion. While combining imitation learning (IL) with online reinforcement learning (RL) can reduce manual supervision, unconstrained exploration in raw hand-action spaces is sample-inefficient and risky for physical hardware. We introduce a latent motion prior module (\prior{}) that maps recent hand-action histories to a compact, history-conditioned latent prior and decodes continuous latent commands into executable high-dimensional hand targets. Built on this prior, \method{} is a three-stage real-world dexterous learning framework: it pretrains \prior{} from demonstrations, trains a visuomotor policy that predicts native arm commands and latent hand-action offsets, and improves the policy with online residual RL in the same latent hand-action space. This shared, decodable interface lets residual exploration make local corrections near demonstrated, contact-consistent hand motions rather than perturbing every finger joint independently. We evaluate \method{} on four real-robot dexterous manipulation tasks against raw, linear, and discrete hand-action interfaces. Starting from small task-specific demonstration sets, \method{} achieves a 56.25\% average IL success rate and raises it to 98.75\% after online RL, reaching 100\% final success on three tasks and 95\% on the remaining task.
tldr: LAMP introduces a latent motion prior module that maps hand-action histories to a compact latent space, enabling sample-efficient dexterous manipulation learning by combining imitation and online RL on real robots.
tldr_zh: LAMP 提出一个潜在运动先验模块，将手部动作历史映射到紧致的潜在空间，通过结合模仿学习和在线强化学习实现真实机器人上的高效灵巧操作学习。
summary_zh: 灵巧手的真实世界学习仍存在脆弱性，因为高维手部动作会放大模仿误差，并使强化学习探索容易导致接触中断。尽管将模仿学习与在线强化学习结合可减少人工监督，但在原始手部动作空间中进行无约束探索不仅样本效率低下，对物理硬件也存在风险。我们提出一种潜在运动先验模块，该模块将近期手部动作历史映射为紧凑的、基于历史条件的潜在先验，并将连续潜在指令解码为可执行的高维手部目标。基于此先验，我们提出了一个三阶段真实世界灵巧学习框架：从示教中预训练潜在动作先验模块，训练能预测原始手臂指令与潜在手部动作偏移的视觉运动策略，并在同一潜在手部动作空间中通过在线残差强化学习优化策略。这种共享且可解码的接口使残差探索能在示教接触一致的手部动作附近进行局部修正，而非独立扰动每个手指关节。我们在四项真实机器人灵巧操作任务中，将所提方法与原始、线性及离散手部动作接口进行对比评估。基于少量任务特定示教数据集，该方法实现了56.25%的平均模仿学习成功率，经在线强化学习后提升至98.75%，其中三项任务最终成功率达100%，剩余一项达95%。

title: Optimal Transport Q-Learning for Flow Policy Steering and Acceleration
summary: Diffusion and flow policies have recently demonstrated remarkable performance in robotic applications by accurately capturing multimodal robot trajectory distributions, especially in the context of vision language action (VLA) models. However, high quality policy performance also requires fast inference and high quality demonstrations, which are often hard to get. Lack of these leads to suboptimal policy behaviors and failure under distribution shifts. In this work we address the problem of fine-tuning and accelerating suboptimal flow-based policies using the robot's experience through RL post-training. We introduce Optimal Transport Q-Learning (OTQL), a new method for finetuning flow policies using advantage weighted conditional optimal transport flow matching. OTQL can finetune and accelerate flows with an interaction budget of 50-60 episodes while avoiding computationally expensive distillation in simulation and real-world robot tasks. Our results show that OTQL post-trains flow policies using the robot's own experience, increasing average success percentage of single-task policies from 36% to 86% and of a pre-trained VLA from 38% to 76% while reducing the number of inference steps per action generation by 70%.
tldr: Introduces OTQL, a method to fine-tune and accelerate suboptimal flow-based policies via RL post-training using advantage-weighted optimal transport flow matching, achieving significant performance gains with minimal interaction.
tldr_zh: 提出OTQL方法，通过基于优势加权的条件最优传输流匹配，利用RL后训练对次优流策略进行微调和加速，在少量交互下显著提升性能。
summary_zh: 扩散与流策略近期在机器人应用中展现了卓越性能，能够精确捕捉多模态机器人轨迹分布，尤其在视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型背景下表现突出。然而，高质量策略性能还需快速推理与优质示范数据，而这些往往难以获取。这些条件的缺失会导致策略行为欠佳，并在分布偏移下出现执行失败。本研究针对这一问题，通过强化学习后训练，利用机器人自身经验对次优的基于流的策略进行微调与加速。我们提出最优传输Q学习（OTQL）——一种采用优势加权条件最优传输流匹配来微流程策略的新方法。OTQL可在50-60个交互轮次的预算内完成流的微调与加速，同时避免在仿真与真实机器人任务中进行高计算成本的蒸馏。实验结果表明：OTQL通过机器人自身经验后训练流策略，将单任务策略的平均成功率从36%提升至86%，预训练VLA的成功率从38%提升至76%，同时将每次动作生成的推理步数减少70%。

title: Diagnosing Semantic Handoff Failures in Agent-Orchestrated Vision-Language-Action Skill Composition
summary: Long-horizon household tasks require robots to compose many language-conditioned skills, yet the boundary between consecutive skills is rarely explicit. A skill may satisfy its own postcondition while leaving the robot, objects, or camera views in a state from which the next skill cannot reliably start. We study this semantic handoff problem in BEHAVIOR-1K through an agent-orchestrated vision-language-action execution harness. The harness invokes $π_{0.5}$-based skill checkpoints trained from cleaned BEHAVIOR-1K demonstrations, assigns each skill typed arguments and a step budget, and uses multi-view vision-language model verification to decide whether execution should advance, retry, or replan. To separate isolated skill competence from long-horizon compositional robustness, we evaluate the same checkpoints under two initial-state distributions: clean skill-boundary snapshots and chained terminal states produced by previous skills. Selected navigation, grasping, placement, and door-opening skills achieve 77--100% success from clean snapshots under human-reviewed verification, yet composed rollouts still frequently stall from chained states. Execution traces attribute these failures to next-skill readiness, target grounding, and low-level control execution, revealing a substantial gap between single-skill success and reliable long-horizon task completion. These findings turn near-zero end-to-end task success into actionable diagnostics, showing that future VLA skill libraries must learn robustness to the messy chained-state distribution that clean demonstrations systematically underrepresent.
tldr: This work diagnoses semantic handoff failures in long-horizon VLA task composition by evaluating multi-view VLM-verified skill checkpoints on BEHAVIOR-1K, revealing a major gap between isolated skill success and compositional robustness due to chained-state distribution mismatch.
tldr_zh: 该研究通过BEHAVIOR-1K上多视角VLM验证的技能检查点评估，诊断了长时域VLA任务组合中的语义交接失败，揭示了孤立技能成功与组合鲁棒性之间的显著差距，归因于链式状态分布的不匹配。
summary_zh: 长时域的家庭任务要求机器人组合多种语言条件技能，但连续技能之间的边界往往并不明确。某项技能可能在满足自身后置条件的同时，使机器人、物体或相机视角处于无法可靠启动下一技能的状态。我们通过BEHAVIOR-1K平台，借助一种由智能体协调的视觉-语言-动作执行框架，研究这一语义交棒问题。该框架调用基于$π_{0.5}$的技能检查点（这些检查点由清洗后的BEHAVIOR-1K演示数据训练而成），为每项技能分配类型化参数和步骤预算，并利用多视角视觉-语言模型验证来判断执行应推进、重试还是重新规划。为将孤立技能能力与长时域组合鲁棒性区分开，我们在两种初始状态分布下对同一检查点进行评估：干净的技能边界快照，以及由先前技能生成的链式终端状态。经人工审核验证，选定的导航、抓取、放置和开门技能在干净快照下的成功率达77%至100%，然而组合后的执行流程仍频繁因链式状态而中断。执行轨迹分析将这些失败归因于下一技能的就绪性、目标锚定以及低级控制执行，揭示了单一技能成功与可靠的长时域任务完成之间的显著差距。这些发现将近乎为零的端到端任务成功率转化为可操作的诊断依据，表明未来的VLA技能库必须具备对混乱链式状态分布的鲁棒性——而干净的演示数据系统性地低估了这种分布特征。

title: Calf-Integrated Arms for Bimanual Quadruped Loco-Manipulation
summary: Most quadruped loco-manipulation designs trade manipulation capability against stance. A trunk-mounted arm sits high and usually carries a single arm; using the legs as manipulators lifts the manipulating leg off the ground; and even leg-mounted grippers reach two-handed tasks only by rearing onto the hind legs. This paper integrates a manipulator with a prismatic slider, two revolute joints, and a gripper into each front calf of a Unitree Go2. The two arms grasp objects at ground level and manipulate with both hands while all four feet stay planted, without rearing. With one arm carrying, the base stays free to walk. A vision-language model sequences skills from a predefined library at each skill boundary, conditioned on the head-camera image and task state, for long-horizon autonomy. In simulation, the design performs three bimanual tasks: a long-horizon cabinet task under autonomous skill selection, a cooperative two-handed lift, and an inter-arm handover.
tldr: This paper presents a novel quadruped robot design with integrated two-joint gripper arms in the front calves, enabling bimanual loco-manipulation without rearing, and uses a VLM for long-horizon task sequencing.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种新型四足机器人设计，将带有两个关节和夹爪的机械臂集成到前小腿中，实现了无需后腿站立的双手操作，并使用视觉语言模型进行长时任务排序。
summary_zh: 大多数四足机器人操作-运动设计需要在操作能力与站立稳定性之间进行权衡。躯干上安装的机械臂位置较高且通常仅配备单臂；将腿部作为操作器使用时，操作腿需离开地面；即便采用腿部安装夹爪的方案，也只有以后腿直立的方式才能完成双手协同任务。本文在宇树Go2机器人每条前小腿上集成了一个包含棱柱滑块、两个旋转关节和夹爪的操作臂。双机械臂能在四足着地（无需后腿直立）的情况下，于地面高度抓取物体并实现双手协同操作。当单臂执行搬运任务时，基座仍可自由行走。视觉语言模型在每个技能边界处，根据头部摄像头图像和任务状态，从预定义技能库中排序选择技能，实现长时域自主操作。仿真环境中，该设计完成了三项双手操作任务：自主技能选择下的长时域柜体操作、双臂协同抬升以及双臂间物体交接。

title: EAGOR: Embodied Reasoning in Omni-direction
summary: Omni-directional (360°) cameras provide embodied agents with a holistic view of their surroundings, making them suited for directional reasoning in tasks such as navigation and object search. Existing Vision Language Models (VLMs) project 360° observations to 2D equirectangular projection (ERP) images and process them using architectures designed for perspective images. However, they ignore the spherical nature of 360° observations, where each pixel represents a viewing direction relative to the agent. Consequently, their direction estimates often become inconsistent under camera view transformations caused by agent motion. This limitation is particularly critical for map-free navigation, where the agent must continuously estimate the target direction in its egocentric frame. We propose EAGOR, a training-free, geometry-aware framework for embodied 360° directional reasoning. Instead of predicting target directions as ERP image coordinates, EAGOR formulates directional reasoning as recursive Bayesian estimation directly on the sphere. It maintains a continuous belief over target directions and propagates it equivariantly under agent motion without training the backbone VLMs. To achieve this, we introduce the Spherical Harmonic Belief Field (SH-BF), whose spherical harmonic representation provides a globally defined, rotation-aware basis for directional estimation on the spherical manifold. This formulation eliminates ERP seam discontinuities, latitude distortions, and interpolation errors. We evaluate EAGOR on two benchmark datasets and real-world experiments with a legged robot across directional reasoning tasks. EAGOR consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving average relative gains of +34.4% and +45.6% on HOS and OSR-Bench, respectively, while improving navigation success by +14.6%, reducing step count by 17.7%, and lowering mean angular error by 24.5%.
tldr: EAGOR introduces a geometry-aware, training-free framework for embodied 360° directional reasoning that uses spherical harmonic belief fields to maintain rotation-equivariant target direction estimates under agent motion.
tldr_zh: EAGOR 提出了一种基于几何感知、无需训练的框架，用于具身360°方向推理，利用球谐信念场在智能体运动下保持目标方向的旋转等变性。
summary_zh: 全向（360°）摄像头为具身智能体提供了对其周围环境的整体视野，使其适用于导航、物体搜索等任务中的方向推理。现有的视觉语言模型（VLM）将360°观测值投影到二维等距柱状投影（ERP）图像上，并使用为透视图像设计的架构进行处理。然而，它们忽略了360°观测的球面特性——每个像素代表相对于智能体的一个观察方向。因此，当智能体运动导致相机视角变换时，其方向估计常常出现不一致性。这一局限性对于无地图导航尤为关键，因为智能体必须持续在其自我中心坐标系中估计目标方向。我们提出EAGOR——一种无需训练、基于几何感知的具身360°方向推理框架。EAGOR不再将目标方向预测为ERP图像坐标，而是直接在球面上将方向推理表述为递归贝叶斯估计。它在球面上维持对目标方向的连续置信度，并在智能体运动下以等变方式传播该置信度，且无需训练骨干VLM。为此，我们引入球谐置信场（SH-BF），其球谐表示在球面流形上为方向估计提供了全局定义且具有旋转感知能力的基函数。该表述消除了ERP的接缝不连续性、纬度畸变和插值误差。我们在两个基准数据集以及使用四足机器人的真实世界实验中，针对方向推理任务对EAGOR进行了评估。EAGOR持续优于现有方法，在HOS和OSR-Bench上分别取得了平均+34.4%和+45.6%的相对性能提升，同时将导航成功率提高了+14.6%，步数减少了17.7%，平均角度误差降低了24.5%。

title: RoboTALES: Learning Reasoning-Guided Robot Policies via Task-Aligned Simulated Futures
summary: Pretrained video generative models are promising backbones for visuomotor control, but their imagined futures often drift from task intent and are not reliably action-conditional. As a result, these models can be difficult to use for planning or policy extraction. To address these limitations, we propose RoboTALES, a single-stage framework that learns task-aligned simulated futures and uses them to train robot policies. Our approach introduces two key innovations: (1) a hierarchical LLM-based planner that breaks complex tasks into a sequence of subgoals to guide the model's imagination; and (2) a VLM-based critic that evaluates these ``imagined'' futures and uses reward-based feedback to keep the model's internal representations focused on the goal. By anchoring the video generator in abstract reasoning, we produce temporally consistent rollouts and more coherent actions. We evaluate RoboTALES on diverse manipulation tasks from RoboCasa and LIBERO10, and show that our method consistently outperforms existing methods, especially in long-horizon tasks. Our code and models are publicly available at https://github.com/hananshafi/RoboTALES.
tldr: RoboTALES is a single-stage framework that uses an LLM-based hierarchical planner and a VLM-based critic to guide a pretrained video generative model, producing task-aligned imagined futures for training robot policies, outperforming existing methods on long-horizon manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: RoboTALES 是一个单阶段框架，利用基于 LLM 的层级规划器和基于 VLM 的评判器来引导预训练视频生成模型，生成与任务对齐的想象未来，用于训练机器人策略，在长时域操作任务上优于现有方法。
summary_zh: 预训练视频生成模型为视觉运动控制提供了有前景的基础架构，但其所想象的未来状态往往偏离任务意图，且无法可靠地实现动作条件化。因此，这类模型难以用于规划或策略提取。为解决这些局限，我们提出RoboTALES——一种单阶段框架，能够学习与任务对齐的模拟未来状态，并利用这些状态训练机器人策略。我们的方法包含两项核心创新：(1) 基于层级化大语言模型的规划器，将复杂任务分解为一系列子目标以引导模型想象；(2) 基于视觉语言模型的评估器，通过评估这些“想象的”未来状态并引入奖励反馈机制，使模型内部表征始终聚焦于任务目标。通过将视频生成器锚定于抽象推理，我们能够生成时序一致的推演结果与更连贯的动作。我们在RoboCasa与LIBERO10的多样化操作任务上评估RoboTALES，结果表明我们的方法持续优于现有方法，尤其在长周期任务中表现突出。我们的代码与模型已开源至https://github.com/hananshafi/RoboTALES。

title: DexTele: A Dual-Arm Dexterous Teleoperation System Based on Motion Retargeting and Adaptive Force Control
summary: In dual-arm dexterous teleoperation, cross-platform generalization of motion retargeting and interactivity of grasping are crucial. However, the heterogeneity of robotic architectures and the wide variety of grasping objects pose significant challenges to achieving precise motion retargeting and compliant grasping in dual-arm dexterous teleoperation. To address these challenges, a dual-arm dexterous teleoperation system (DexTele) is proposed based on motion retargeting and adaptive force control. First, a vision-based motion retargeting module is designed to generate preliminary robot motions from human images. In this module, a motion-graph encoder and latent optimization are proposed for precise and convenient cross-platform motion retargeting. Second, an adaptive grasping module is designed to achieve compliant grasping. This module combines a vision-language model (VLM) with model predictive control (MPC), allowing the system to predict the required grasping force for a target object and perform gradient-based online optimization. Finally, extensive experiments demonstrate that the DexTele achieves precise motion retargeting and compliant grasping with generalization across multiple robot platforms.
tldr: A dual-arm dexterous teleoperation system that uses a vision-based motion retargeting module with a motion-graph encoder and latent optimization for cross-platform generalization, and integrates a VLM with MPC for adaptive grasping force control.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种基于运动重定向和自适应力控制的双臂灵巧遥操作系统的方案，通过视觉运动重定向模块与视觉-语言模型结合模型预测控制实现跨平台推广和自适应抓取。
summary_zh: 在双臂灵巧遥操作中，运动重定向的跨平台泛化能力与抓取操作的交互性至关重要。然而，机器人架构的异构性以及抓取物体的多样性，给实现双臂灵巧遥操作中的精确运动重定向和柔顺抓取带来了重大挑战。为应对这些挑战，本文提出了一种基于运动重定向与自适应力控制的双臂灵巧遥操作系统（DexTele）。首先，设计了一个基于视觉的运动重定向模块，用于从人体图像生成初步的机器人运动。在该模块中，提出了运动图编码器和隐式优化方法，以实现精确且便捷的跨平台运动重定向。其次，设计了一个自适应抓取模块来实现柔顺抓取。该模块将视觉语言模型（VLM）与模型预测控制（MPC）相结合，使系统能够预测目标物体所需的抓取力，并进行基于梯度的在线优化。最后，大量实验表明，DexTele 系统在多个机器人平台上具备精确运动重定向与柔顺抓取的泛化能力。

title: FORGE: Towards Functional Tool-Use Generalization via Keypoint Trajectory Reasoning
summary: While humans readily repurpose a book, a stone, or a shoe to drive a nail, robots trained on specific tools fail to transfer the same function to novel ones -- a gap we formalize as functional generalization. Such tools share a common functional intent that is visually recognizable, yet this perceptual similarity does not carry over to action space, where each tool demands an entirely different motor pattern. To bridge this gap, we explore intermediate representations including affordance images, human video prompts, and 2D keypoint trajectories, finding that keypoint trajectories best balance functional expressiveness and action groundability. Building on this, we propose FunctiOnal Reasoning and Grounded Execution (FORGE), a two-stage policy that decouples functional reasoning from action execution: predicting generalizable keypoint trajectories from action-free data, then grounding them into robot actions with limited demonstrations. On a seven-tool hitting-function benchmark, FORGE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods on unseen tools in both simulation and the real world, achieving over 2X improvement in average success rate.
tldr: Proposes FORGE, a two-stage policy that decouples functional reasoning (predicting keypoint trajectories from action-free data) from action execution, enabling robots to generalize tool use to novel unseen tools with over 2X success rate improvement.
tldr_zh: 提出FORGE，一种将功能推理（从无动作数据预测关键点轨迹）与动作执行解耦的两阶段策略，使机器人能泛化工具使用到未见过的工具，成功率提升超2倍。
summary_zh: 虽然人类可以轻松地用一本书、一块石头或一只鞋来钉钉子，但经过特定工具训练的机器人却无法将相同功能迁移至新工具——我们将这一差距形式化为功能泛化。这类工具具有视觉可识别的共同功能意图，但这种感知相似性无法延伸至动作空间，因为每种工具需要截然不同的运动模式。为弥合这一差距，我们探索了包括可供性图像、人类视频提示和二维关键点轨迹在内的中间表征，发现关键点轨迹在功能表达性与动作可落地性之间取得了最佳平衡。基于此，我们提出功能推理与接地执行（FORGE）这一两阶段策略：将功能推理与动作执行解耦——先基于无动作数据预测可泛化的关键点轨迹，再通过少量示范将其接地为机器人动作。在包含七种工具的击打功能基准测试中，FORGE在模拟环境和真实世界中均持续优于现有最优方法，在未见工具上的平均成功率提升超两倍。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Velocity Correction for Proprioceptive Vehicle Localization using Evidential Mamba
summary: Reliable localization in GNSS-denied environments remains a fundamental challenge for intelligent vehicles, as inertial navigation systems accumulate unbounded drift without external correction. Existing approaches provide drift correction through dedicated infrastructure, expensive external sensors, or complex multi-sensor fusion, each introducing practical deployment barriers. We propose Evidential Velocity Correction using Mamba (EVC-Mamba), a learning-based architecture that transforms onboard vehicle sensor data into a virtual velocity sensor for IMU drift correction without additional hardware. A Mamba-based selective state space model captures the temporal dynamics of vehicle motion, while evidential deep learning with a Normal-Inverse-Gamma distribution provides principled uncertainty quantification. The resulting uncertainty-aware velocity estimate is incorporated as a virtual correction measurement into an Error-State Extended Kalman Filter to reduce position drift. Evaluation on real-world vehicle data demonstrates that inertial navigation using the proposed velocity correction achieves localization accuracy within 10% of a dedicated external velocity sensor across different outage durations. The proposed architecture supports real-time onboard deployment at 40 Hz on edge hardware, enabling reliable localization during prolonged GNSS outages.
tldr: This paper proposes EVC-Mamba, a learning-based architecture using Mamba and evidential deep learning to estimate velocity from onboard vehicle sensors for IMU drift correction in GNSS-denied environments, achieving real-time localization accuracy comparable to external sensors.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了EVC-Mamba，一种基于Mamba和证据深度学习的架构，利用车载传感器数据估计速度以校正IMU漂移，在GNSS缺失环境下实现接近外部传感器的定位精度，并支持实时部署。
summary_zh: 摘要：在无GNSS环境中实现可靠定位仍是智能车辆面临的基础性挑战，原因是惯性导航系统若无外部校正会积累无界漂移。现有方法通过专用基础设施、昂贵的外部传感器或复杂的多传感器融合提供漂移校正，但每种方法都存在实际部署障碍。本文提出基于Mamba的证据速度校正方法（EVC-Mamba），这是一种基于学习的架构，可将车载传感器数据转化为虚拟速度传感器用于IMU漂移校正，无需额外硬件。基于Mamba的选择性状态空间模型捕捉车辆运动的时序动态特性，而采用正态逆伽马分布的证据深度学习则可提供理论严谨的不确定性量化。最终将具有不确定性感知的速度估计作为虚拟校正测量值，融入误差状态扩展卡尔曼滤波器以减少位置漂移。基于真实车辆数据的实验表明，采用所提速度校正方法的惯性导航系统，在不同中断时长下定位精度均达到专用外部速度传感器的10%以内。该架构支持在边缘硬件上以40Hz频率进行实时车载部署，可在长时间GNSS中断期间实现可靠定位。

title: A Definition and Roadmap for World Models
summary: World models -- internal simulators that learn the structure and dynamics of an environment -- have become one of the most actively debated concepts in AI. From model-based reinforcement learning and video generation to embodied robotics and ultimately, physical AI, researchers across AI subfields are building systems that they call "world models", yet there is no consensus on what a world model fundamentally is, what it should predict, or how it should be built. This perspective article provides a scientific definition of world models, discussions of their key technical aspects, and a staged roadmap for developing effective world models.
tldr: A perspective article proposing a scientific definition and a staged roadmap for world models, positioned as foundational for robotics, embodied AI, and physical AI.
tldr_zh: 一篇观点文章，提出了世界模型的科学定义和分阶段路线图，将其定位为机器人技术、具身AI和物理AI的基础。
summary_zh: 世界模型——能够学习环境结构与动态特性的内部模拟器——已成为人工智能领域讨论最激烈的概念之一。从基于模型的强化学习与视频生成，到具身机器人技术乃至终极的物理人工智能，各AI子领域的研究者都在构建他们所谓的"世界模型"系统，然而对于世界模型的基本定义、预测目标或构建方法，学界尚未形成共识。本文以视角论文的形式，提出了世界模型的科学定义，探讨了其关键技术问题，并制定了开发有效世界模型的分阶段路线图。

title: Point as Skeleton: Accumulated Point Cloud Enhanced Autoregressive Generation for Closed-Loop Autonomous Driving Simulation
summary: Evaluating end-to-end autonomous driving (E2E-AD) remains challenging, as existing driving simulation methods often trade off closed-loop interactivity (e.g., CARLA) and real-world visual fidelity (e.g., nuScenes). We present \textbf{\emph{Point as Skeleton}}, a generative sensor simulation framework for state-updated autoregressive driving video generation, in which an autoregressive generator synthesizes visual observations from step-wise updated ego states, actor states, scene maps, and point-cloud skeleton conditions. To support closed-loop rollout, we introduce Reset-and-Roll, which adapts rolling diffusion inference to simulation by preventing future-conditioned latent states from being committed across simulation steps. To stabilize error accumulation during step-wise autoregressive rollout, we introduce point-cloud skeletons that decouple foreground and background assets and project them into camera-view painted-point and template-depth conditions, providing appearance and geometric cues. We further implement a nuPlan-based renderer-level closed-loop generative interface for evaluating generation under ego deviations from the original log. Experiments on nuScenes and nuPlan show that \textit{Point as Skeleton} improves autoregressive generation quality during closed-loop rollout, demonstrating its potential for visually faithful closed-loop driving simulation. The code is available at https://github.com/krauwu/point-as-skeleton.
tldr: Point as Skeleton introduces a generative sensor simulation framework for closed-loop autonomous driving that uses accumulated point clouds as structural conditions to stabilize autoregressive video generation during step-wise rollout.
tldr_zh: Point作为骨架提出了一个用于闭环自动驾驶的生成式传感器仿真框架，利用累积点云作为结构条件来稳定逐步自回归视频生成中的累积误差。
summary_zh: 评估端到端自动驾驶（E2E-AD）仍具有挑战性，现有驾驶仿真方法往往在闭环交互性（如CARLA）与真实世界视觉保真度（如nuScenes）之间进行权衡。本文提出 \textbf{\emph{Point as Skeleton}}——一种用于状态更新的自回归驾驶视频生成的生成式传感器仿真框架。在该框架中，自回归生成器基于逐步更新的自车状态、参与者状态、场景地图及点云骨架条件，合成视觉观测数据。为支持闭环推演，我们引入 Reset-and-Roll 方法，通过避免未来条件潜在状态在仿真步骤间被固化，使滚动扩散推理适配仿真场景。为稳定逐步自回归推演过程中的误差累积，我们引入点云骨架来解耦前景与背景资产，并将其投影为相机视角的涂色点条件与模板深度条件，提供外观与几何线索。此外，我们基于 nuPlan 构建了渲染器级闭环生成接口，用于评估自车轨迹偏离原始日志时的生成质量。在 nuScenes 与 nuPlan 上的实验表明，\textit{Point as Skeleton} 在闭环推演过程中提升了自回归生成质量，展现了其在视觉保真的闭环驾驶仿真中的应用潜力。代码已开源：https://github.com/krauwu/point-as-skeleton。

title: Synthetic-to-Real Translation for Class-Agnostic Motion Prediction
summary: Motion understanding is critical for ensuring safety and robustness in autonomous driving systems, driving increasing interest in motion prediction. A key challenge in this domain is the high cost associated with acquiring real-world motion labels. It is therefore ideal if we could transfer motion knowledge from synthetic data to real data. In this context, we explore the potential of synthetic-to-real translation for motion prediction (SRMP). However, the most used naive motion regression methods are notably sensitive to the synthetic-to-real domain shift, resulting in unreliable knowledge translation. To address this, we propose a novel approach integrating a motion knowledge translation framework with two key components: (1) objectness-aware motion prediction, which explicitly models the joint distribution of motion patterns and objectness priors to improve domain-invariant feature learning, and (2) objectness-aided motion enhancement, a motion label refinement mechanism that leverages learned objectness priors to filter motion noise. Furthermore, we present a physically-based pipeline for generating Motion4D, the first synthetic 4D LiDAR dataset tailored for SRMP research, addressing the lack of synthetic motion datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that our approach effectively bridges the domain gaps and yields superior performance on real scenes.
tldr: Proposes a synthetic-to-real translation framework for motion prediction in autonomous driving, integrating objectness-aware prediction and a physically-based synthetic 4D LiDAR dataset (Motion4D) to reduce domain shift.
tldr_zh: 提出一种用于自动驾驶运动预测的合成到真实转换框架，结合目标感知预测和物理合成的4D LiDAR数据集（Motion4D），以减少域差异。
summary_zh: 运动理解对于确保自动驾驶系统的安全性和鲁棒性至关重要，因此运动预测日益受到关注。该领域面临的一项关键挑战是获取真实世界运动标注的高昂成本。因此，若能实现从合成数据到真实数据的运动知识迁移，将具有理想性。在此背景下，我们探索了面向运动预测的合成到真实数据翻译（SRMP）的潜力。然而，最常用的朴素运动回归方法对合成到真实的领域迁移极为敏感，导致知识迁移不可靠。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的方法，将运动知识迁移框架与两个关键组件相结合：（1）目标感知运动预测，通过显式建模运动模式与目标先验的联合分布，提升领域不变特征学习能力；（2）目标辅助运动增强，一种利用学习到的目标先验对运动标签进行精炼以过滤运动噪声的机制。此外，我们提出了一种基于物理的流程，用于生成Motion4D——首个专为SRMP研究设计的合成4D激光雷达数据集，以弥补合成运动数据集的缺失。实验结果表明，我们的方法有效弥合了领域差距，并在真实场景中展现出优越性能。

title: MoWorld: A Flash World Model
summary: The future of World Models depends not only on scaling model capability, but also on scaling practicality and inference efficiency. High-frame-rate inference enables responsive perception, planning, and control in real-world autonomous systems. To this end, we present MoWorld, a cost-effective yet high-performance Flash World Model with an end-to-end framework spanning data generation, pre-training, distillation, and efficient inference, enabling up to 50 FPS real-time interaction with cinematic visual quality without the need of high-end GPUs. To enable large-scale real-world deployment, MoWorld jointly optimizes model capability and cost throughout the entire development pipeline. Specifically, unlike existing approaches that primarily rely on large-scale video corpora, MoWorld is built upon a scalable 3D-native data engine accumulated from our large-scale 3D vision and generative modeling pipeline, enabling the efficient construction of geometrically consistent training data across diverse real-world and synthetic environments. Based on this foundation, a curriculum cross-frame pre-training strategy for stable and scalable World Model learning, an efficient denoising-step distillation algorithm to reduce diffusion training cost, and a mixed-precision parallel inference framework for low-cost real-time deployment. MoWorld is the first real-time interactive World Model built on the Neural Processing Unit (NPU) and can achieves up to 50 FPS in such the devices, enabling practical and efficient deployment at scale. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that MoWorld achieves leading performance; notably, its average inference cost is only 30\%-50\% of that of existing World Models, providing a practical foundation for large-scale real-world applications of World Models. We also demonstrate diverse applications of MoWorld.
tldr: MoWorld presents a real-time interactive world model achieving up to 50 FPS on Neural Processing Units, with an end-to-end pipeline including a 3D-native data engine, curriculum cross-frame pre-training, efficient denoising-step distillation, and mixed-precision parallel inference.
tldr_zh: MoWorld 提出了一种实时交互式世界模型，可在神经处理单元上达到高达 50 FPS 的推理速度，其端到端框架包括 3D 原生数据引擎、课程式跨帧预训练、高效去噪步蒸馏和混合精度并行推理。
summary_zh: 世界模型的未来发展不仅取决于模型能力的扩展，更取决于实用性与推理效率的提升。高帧率推理能够赋能真实世界自主系统中的响应式感知、规划与控制。为此，我们提出MoWorld——一种经济高效的高性能闪存世界模型，其端到端框架涵盖数据生成、预训练、蒸馏与高效推理，无需高端GPU即可实现高达50 FPS的实时交互与电影级视觉质量。为支撑大规模真实世界部署，MoWorld在整个开发流程中对模型能力与成本进行联合优化。具体而言，与主要依赖大规模视频语料库的现有方法不同，MoWorld基于从我们大规模3D视觉与生成建模流程中积累的可扩展3D原生数据引擎构建，能够高效生成跨多样真实与合成环境的几何一致性训练数据。在此基础之上，我们提出：面向稳定可扩展世界模型学习的课程式跨帧预训练策略、降低扩散训练成本的高效去噪步长蒸馏算法，以及面向低成本实时部署的混合精度并行推理框架。MoWorld是首个基于神经处理单元（NPU）构建的实时交互式世界模型，在该类设备上可实现高达50 FPS的帧率，支持大规模实用化高效部署。全面评估表明，MoWorld取得了领先性能；值得注意的是，其平均推理成本仅为现有世界模型的30%-50%，为世界模型的大规模实际应用提供了实用基础。我们还展示了MoWorld的多样化应用场景。

title: Benchmarking the Robustness of Autonomous Driving to Environmental Illusions: A Lane Perception Perspective
summary: Environmental illusions (eg., shadows, reflections, and tire marks) are naturally existing yet overlooked phenomena in real-world driving environments. They can disturb visual perception, leading to misinterpretation of the scene and posing serious safety risks to autonomous driving (AD) systems. However, existing researches largely overlook these phenomena, leaving a critical gap. To address this issue, we study AD robustness through the lane perception perspective, a fundamental task supporting core functions like cruise control and lane centering. We focus on two representative models: conventional lane detection (LD) and vision-language model-based systems (ADVLMs). In this work, we introduce the first benchmark, LanEvil++, for evaluating the robustness of lane perception under environmental illusions. LanEvil++ encompasses 14 types of illusions and leverages the CARLA simulator to generate 94 high-fidelity, fully controllable 3D scenes, yielding a dataset of 90,292 annotated images, 1,596 video clips, and 41,855 visual question answering pairs. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that environmental illusions substantially degrade the performance of state-of-the-art LD methods. On average, LD models experience a 5.27% drop in Accuracy and a 10.49% decline in F1-score, while ADVLMs show a 2.03% reduction in GPT-score and a 0.75% drop in Language-score. Among all illusions, shadows emerge as the most disruptive factor, reducing accuracy by up to 7.20%. Furthermore, closed-loop simulations reveal that these illusions can lead to incorrect driving decisions. Complementary real-world case studies highlight safety-critical failures in actual traffic scenes. To enhance robustness, we propose the Multimodal Illusion Defense Approach (MIDA). MIDA achieves substantial gains under challenging conditions, boosting robustness by 4.23% on LD models and 3.82% on ADVLMs.
tldr: This paper introduces LanEvil++, a benchmark for evaluating the robustness of lane perception (both conventional detection and VLM-based systems) to environmental illusions like shadows and reflections in autonomous driving, and proposes a multimodal defense method.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了LanEvil++基准，用于评估自动驾驶中车道感知（包括传统检测和VLM系统）对阴影、反射等环境幻觉的鲁棒性，并提出了一种多模态防御方法。
summary_zh: 环境幻觉（例如阴影、反射和轮胎痕迹）是真实驾驶环境中自然存在却常被忽视的现象。它们会干扰视觉感知，导致场景误判，并对自动驾驶系统构成严重安全隐患。然而，现有研究大多忽略这些现象，形成了关键空白。为解决此问题，我们从车道感知视角研究自动驾驶鲁棒性——这一支撑巡航控制、车道居中功能的基础任务，聚焦两类代表性模型：传统车道检测模型与基于视觉语言模型的系统。本研究首次提出基准测试LanEvil++，用于评估环境幻觉下车道感知的鲁棒性。LanEvil++涵盖14种幻觉类型，利用CARLA模拟器生成94个高保真、全可控三维场景，构建包含90,292张标注图像、1,596段视频片段及41,855组视觉问答对的数据集。大量评估表明，环境幻觉显著降低了最先进车道检测方法的性能。平均而言，车道检测模型准确率下降5.27%，F1分数下降10.49%；视觉语言模型系统GPT分数降低2.03%，语言分数下降0.75%。在所有幻觉类型中，阴影成为最具破坏性因素，导致准确率最高降低7.20%。此外，闭环仿真显示这些幻觉会引发错误驾驶决策。补充的真实场景案例研究揭示了实际交通场景中的关键安全故障。为提升鲁棒性，我们提出多模态幻觉防御方法MIDA。该方法在挑战性条件下实现显著增益，使车道检测模型鲁棒性提升4.23%，视觉语言模型系统鲁棒性提升3.82%。

title: Hypothesis-driven Model Expansion under Uncertainty for Open-World Robot Planning
summary: We consider an open-world planning setting in which service robots must operate in unknown environments with incomplete knowledge of objects and actions. Traditional closed-world approaches with pre-programmed knowledge bases fail when robots encounter unexpected situations and tasks, posing a fundamental challenge for autonomous knowledge expansion in human environments. In this work, we propose an open-world planning framework that enables robots to automatically generate, verify, and update hypotheses about their abstract world models. Our key insight is to explicitly maintain uncertainty-aware knowledge expansion and integrate hypothesis verification into goal-reaching planning. The framework leverages foundation models to generate initial hypotheses over states and transitions, and applies automated planning to produce action sequences that jointly address hypothesis verification and task execution. Through iterative execution and refinement, the robot expands its knowledge by incorporating verification feedback from the foundation models when hypotheses prove incorrect. Extensive experiments in simulated and real-world environments demonstrate that our framework enables autonomous knowledge expansion and effective operation in open-world settings. These results indicate that integrating uncertainty-aware model expansion from robot foundation models with planning advances the practical deployment of household service robots.
tldr: This paper proposes an open-world planning framework that enables service robots to autonomously generate, verify, and update hypotheses about their world models by integrating uncertainty-aware knowledge expansion with foundation models and automated planning.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出一种开放世界规划框架，使服务机器人能够通过将不确定性感知的知识扩展与基础模型和自动规划相结合，自主生成、验证和更新关于其世界模型的假设。
summary_zh: 我们考虑一种开放世界规划场景，其中服务机器人必须在未知环境中运行，且对物体和动作的知识不完整。当机器人遇到意外情况和任务时，依赖预编程知识库的封闭世界方法会失效，这为机器人在人类环境中自主扩展知识带来了根本性挑战。本研究提出一种开放世界规划框架，使机器人能够自动生成、验证并更新关于其抽象世界模型的假设。我们的核心见解是显式地维护具有不确定性意识的知识扩展，并将假设验证整合到目标导向的规划中。该框架利用基础模型生成关于状态和转移的初始假设，并应用自动规划生成同时兼顾假设验证与任务执行的动作序列。通过迭代执行与优化，当假设经基础模型验证为错误时，机器人通过整合验证反馈来扩展自身知识。在仿真与真实环境中的大量实验表明，我们的框架能够支持机器人在开放世界场景中实现自主知识扩展与有效运行。这些结果证明，将基于机器人基础模型的具不确定性意识模型扩展与规划相结合，可推动家庭服务机器人的实际部署。

title: Clustering-Embedded Model Predictive Path Integral Control: Avoiding Averaging-Induced Failure and Enabling Efficient Cluster Selection for Dynamic Obstacles
summary: With the widespread availability of parallel computing hardware, sampling-based motion planning methods such as Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control have become increasingly powerful for complex nonlinear systems in non-smooth task spaces. However, the sampling and forward-simulation pipeline in MPPI suffers from averaging-induced failure in cluttered environments, where the importance-weighted update averages incompatible rollouts and leads to hesitation or even collision when an obstacle lies directly ahead. This paper proposes Clustering-Embedded MPPI (CE-MPPI), a framework that architecturally resolves the averaging-induced failures inherent in standard MPPI within non-convex environments. Rather than simply mitigating interference, CE-MPPI redefines the control law by integrating a high-fidelity pruning and clustering stage. By leveraging density-based spatial clustering of applications with noise (DBSCAN) alongside a novel geometric direction feature that is extracted from collision-derived reference points, the system isolates feasible trajectory modes from the noise of infeasible rollouts. This is paired with an intelligent selection logic that optimizes for minimum cost in static scenes while actively steering opposite to obstacle flux in dynamic environments. Experiments in 2-D JAX-accelerated simulations show that CE-MPPI alleviates obstacle-front hesitation and avoids persistent coupling with moving obstacles in dynamic scenes. In particular, real-world tests on a 6-DoF UR5e manipulator with CUDA-parallel rollouts in Isaac Gym achieve a 48\% reduction in time-to-goal and a 12\% shorter end-effector path.
tldr: CE-MPPI integrates DBSCAN clustering with a novel geometric direction feature to isolate feasible trajectory modes and avoid averaging-induced failures in standard MPPI, demonstrating improved performance on a 6-DoF UR5e manipulator.
tldr_zh: CE-MPPI 通过集成 DBSCAN 聚类和一种新的几何方向特征来隔离可行轨迹模式，避免标准 MPPI 中的平均诱导失败，并在 6 自由度 UR5e 机械臂上展示了改进的性能。
summary_zh: 随着并行计算硬件的广泛普及，基于采样的运动规划方法（如模型预测路径积分控制，MPPI）在处理非光滑任务空间中的复杂非线性系统时愈发强大。然而，MPPI中的采样与前向仿真流程在杂乱环境中存在平均化引发的失效问题：当障碍物正前方出现时，重要性加权更新会融合不兼容的轨迹展开，导致系统犹豫不决甚至发生碰撞。本文提出聚类嵌入型MPPI（CE-MPPI）框架，该框架从架构层面解决了标准MPPI在非凸环境中固有的平均化失效问题。CE-MPPI并非简单缓解干扰，而是通过集成高保真剪枝与聚类阶段重新定义控制律。该系统利用基于密度的噪声应用空间聚类（DBSCAN）方法，结合从碰撞衍生参考点中提取的新型几何方向特征，将可行轨迹模式与不可行展开的噪声分离开来。配合智能选择逻辑，该逻辑在静态场景中优化最小成本，同时在动态环境中引导系统主动避开障碍物通量。在二维JAX加速仿真中的实验表明，CE-MPPI能够缓解障碍物前的犹豫行为，并避免在动态场景中与移动障碍物持续耦合。特别地，在搭载CUDA并行展开技术的Isaac Gym环境中针对六自由度UR5e机械臂进行的实际测试显示，其到达目标的时间减少48%，末端执行器路径缩短12%。

title: Towards Reliable Aerial Ground Vehicle Collaboration: An Integrated Planning and Autonomy Framework for Field Deployment
summary: Limited flight endurance significantly restricts the operational range of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in long duration missions such as surveillance and inspection, where multiple spatially distributed Areas of Interest (AOIs) must be visited. These tasks require efficient routing determining the sequence of visits which directly impacts mission time, energy consumption, and overall feasibility. Pairing UAVs with unmanned ground vehicles (UGVs) for mobile recharging offers a promising solution, but introduces a tightly coupled cooperative routing problem involving UAV route planning, UGV road constrained movement, energy management, and rendezvous scheduling under uncertainty. In this work, we present an integrated planning and autonomy framework for reliable field deployment. We formulate the problem as an energy constrained cooperative routing task and solve it using a Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) based planner that jointly optimizes the UAV visitation sequence and rendezvous locations with the UGV, outperforming baseline heuristics in minimizing total mission time. To bridge the gap between planning and execution, we introduce a standardized two layer YAML based mission API that captures environment states and structures lightweight, synchronized action sequences. This framework is supported by a complete autonomy stack using PX4/MAVSDK for UAV control and ROS 2/Nav2 for UGV navigation. Furthermore, we propose a lightweight Rendezvous Aware Replanner (RARP) that operates online to handle environmental uncertainties, reducing energy margin violations from 83.33% to 20.00%. The full system is validated through outdoor field experiments, demonstrating robust cooperative navigation and adaptability in dynamic tasks, including a search and rescue scenario with vision language model (VLM) based hazard detection
tldr: A DRL-based cooperative planning and autonomy framework for UAV-UGV teams that jointly optimizes routing and rendezvous for extended aerial missions, validated through outdoor field experiments including VLM-driven hazard detection.
tldr_zh: 提出一种基于深度强化学习的无人机-无人车协同规划与自主框架，联合优化航点访问顺序与会合位置，并通过户外实验（含VLM危险检测）验证了其在动态任务中的有效性。
summary_zh: 有限的飞行续航能力显著限制了无人机在长时间任务（如监视与巡检）中的作业范围，此类任务需要访问多个空间分布的兴趣区域。这类任务要求高效的路由规划以确定访问顺序，这直接影响任务时间、能耗及整体可行性。将无人机与地面无人车辆配对以实现移动充电是一种有前景的解决方案，但由此引出紧密耦合的协同路由问题，涉及无人机路径规划、地面车辆道路受限移动、能量管理以及不确定性条件下的会合调度。在本研究中，我们提出了一套用于可靠现场部署的集成规划与自主框架。我们将该问题建模为能量约束的协同路由任务，并采用基于深度强化学习的规划器进行求解，该规划器联合优化无人机访问序列及与地面车辆的会合位置，在最小化总任务时间方面优于基线启发式方法。为弥合规划与执行之间的鸿沟，我们引入了一个基于YAML的标准双层任务应用程序接口，该接口能捕获环境状态并构建轻量级、同步化的动作序列。该框架由完整的自主技术栈支撑，其中无人机控制采用PX4/MAVSDK，地面车辆导航采用ROS 2/Nav2。此外，我们提出了一种轻量级的会合感知重规划器，该模块在线运行以应对环境不确定性，将能量裕度违规率从83.33%降低至20.00%。整套系统通过室外现场实验验证，展现了在动态任务中的稳健协同导航与自适应能力，包括基于视觉语言模型的危险检测搜救场景。

title: Learning to Throw Objects Safely in Multi-Obstacle Environments
summary: Robotic throwing enables fast and efficient object placement beyond the robot's immediate workspace, but reliable throwing in cluttered environments remains underexplored. Existing approaches, such as TossingBot, learn throwing strategies from visual input but assume obstacle-free settings. In this paper, we address the problem of throwing objects into a target basket while avoiding obstacles placed randomly in the scene. We introduce a potential field state representation that compactly encodes both basket attraction and obstacle repulsion on a fixed-size grid, enabling reinforcement learning (RL) policies to generalize across arbitrary numbers and configurations of obstacles. The policy is initialized from kinesthetic demonstrations and optimized in simulation using three state-of-the-art RL algorithms (SAC, DDPG, TD3). Among these, SAC achieves the most consistent performance across scenarios. We compare the potential field representation against explicit state encodings and demonstrate that it achieves higher success rates and better scalability to unseen obstacle configurations. Real-robot experiments with unseen throwable objects confirm robust sim-to-real transfer, achieving up to $90\%$ success in cluttered scenes. These results demonstrate that PFR provides a practical and robust representation for safe and efficient robotic throwing in unstructured environments. A video showcasing our experiments is available at: https://youtu.be/ZZnJf8ua2dE
tldr: This paper proposes a potential field state representation for RL-based robotic throwing that avoids obstacles, achieving robust sim-to-real transfer with up to 90% success in cluttered scenes.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于基于强化学习的机器人投掷的势场状态表示，可避开障碍物，在杂乱场景中实现了高达90%的成功率及稳健的仿真到现实迁移。
summary_zh: 机器人投掷能够实现超出机器人直接工作范围的快速高效物体放置，但在杂乱环境中的可靠投掷仍未得到充分研究。现有方法（如TossingBot）虽然能通过视觉输入学习投掷策略，但其前提假设是无障碍环境。本文针对将物体投入目标篮筐、同时避开场景中随机放置障碍物的问题展开研究。我们提出了一种势场状态表示方法，该方法在固定尺寸网格上紧凑编码篮筐引力与障碍物斥力，使强化学习策略能够泛化至任意数量和配置的障碍物。该策略通过动觉示教初始化，并利用三种最先进的强化学习算法（SAC、DDPG、TD3）在仿真中进行优化。其中，SAC在各类场景中表现出最稳定性能。我们将势场表示与显式状态编码进行对比，结果表明前者具有更高的成功率和更好的可扩展性，能够应对未见的障碍物配置。使用未见过投掷物的真实机器人实验验证了稳健的仿真到现实迁移能力，在杂乱场景中成功率达90%。这些结果表明，势场表示为非结构化环境中的安全高效机器人投掷提供了实用且鲁棒的表示方法。展示实验的视频见：https://youtu.be/ZZnJf8ua2dE

title: ThorArena: Benchmarking Humanoid Physical Interaction with Human Motion-Force Demonstrations
summary:
Humanoid robots are increasingly expected to perform contact-rich tasks that require not only accurate whole-body motion but also robust physical interaction with surrounding objects and humans. Although recent advances in humanoid motion imitation and whole-body control have achieved remarkable tracking performance, existing datasets and benchmarks primarily focus on kinematic motion while largely overlooking synchronized interaction forces. As a result, current evaluations fail to capture how external interaction forces affect tracking accuracy, stability, and control robustness.
  In this paper, we present ThorArena, a benchmark for evaluating force-aware humanoid interaction based on human demonstrations with synchronized motion and force measurements. We collect a real-world interaction dataset that simultaneously captures whole-body human motion and forces exerted by both hands across six representative physical interaction tasks. Based on these demonstrations, we propose force-aware evaluation metrics that jointly assess whole-body tracking accuracy, robustness under different force levels, control effort, and episode survival through the Force-Aware Tracking Score (FATS) and complementary diagnostic metrics. We further establish a unified benchmark protocol that replays recorded interaction forces in simulation and provides a standardized evaluation interface for different humanoid control policies.
  Experiments on representative whole-body control policies demonstrate that force-aware evaluation reveals substantial performance differences that remain largely hidden under conventional no-force evaluation. ThorArena provides a practical and reproducible framework for studying force-aware humanoid interaction and offers a new benchmark for evaluating contact-rich humanoid behaviors.
tldr: ThorArena is a benchmark for evaluating force-aware whole-body control on humanoid robots, using human motion-force demonstrations across six contact-rich interaction tasks and introducing force-aware metrics like FATS.
tldr_zh: ThorArena 是一个用于评估人形机器人受力全身控制的基准，利用六种接触式交互任务中的人体运动-力演示，并引入如 FATS 等受力感知指标。
summary_zh:
人形机器人正日益被期望执行需密集接触的任务，这类任务不仅要求精准的全身运动，还需要与周围物体及人类进行稳健的物理交互。尽管近年来人形机器人运动模仿与全身控制技术取得了显著的跟踪性能提升，但现有数据集与基准测试主要关注运动学动作，很大程度上忽略了同步的交互力。因此，当前的评估体系无法捕捉外部交互力对跟踪精度、稳定性及控制鲁棒性的影响。

本文提出了ThorArena基准测试，基于同步采集运动与力测量数据的人类演示，用于评估力感知人形交互。我们构建了一个真实世界交互数据集，该数据集同步捕获了六类典型物理交互任务中的全身人体运动及双手施加的力。基于这些演示，我们提出了力感知评估指标，通过力感知跟踪分数（FATS）与互补诊断指标，综合评估全身跟踪精度、不同力水平下的鲁棒性、控制代价及任务持续存活时长。我们还建立了统一的基准测试协议，可在仿真环境中复现记录的交互力，并为不同人形控制策略提供标准化的评估接口。

在代表性全身控制策略上的实验表明，力感知评估揭示了在传统无外力评估中基本隐藏的显著性能差异。ThorArena为研究力感知人形交互提供了实用且可复现的框架，并为评估密集接触型人形行为提供了新基准。

title: Imagined Rollouts are Kinematic, Not Dynamic: A Diagnosis of Long-Horizon World-Model Failure
summary: Long-horizon failure in world models is conventionally attributed to compounding error, a generic framing that does not distinguish what kind of error compounds. We propose a kinematic-vs-dynamic reframing: world models tend to imagine kinematically rather than dynamically. We operationalize this as the imagined Kinematic-Consistency Error, a per-step diagnostic that measures how far a rollout departs from a closed-form kinematic null, paired with a perturbation protocol that tests whether iKCE responds when physical conditions cross a regime boundary. We instantiate the diagnostic on a released DreamerV3 checkpoint trained on DMC walker-walk, where imagined iKCE runs roughly two orders of magnitude above that of matched real-physics rollouts. Across a friction sweep that crosses the gait-collapse boundary, the model's iKCE stays statistically flat even as the trained policy's reward collapses through the same range, providing the kinematic-not-dynamic signature. The diagnostic distinguishes kinematic from dynamic imagination at horizons longer than the embodiment's gait period.
tldr: This paper diagnoses long-horizon failure in world models by proposing a kinematic-vs-dynamic reframing, introducing a diagnostic (iKCE) to show that DreamerV3 rollouts remain kinematic even when physical conditions change, revealing the model's failure to capture dynamics.
tldr_zh: 该论文通过提出运动学与动力学的重新框架来诊断世界模型的长时域失败，引入了一种诊断方法(iKCE)，表明DreamerV3的 rollout 即使在物理条件变化时仍保持运动学特性，揭示了模型无法捕捉动力学的缺陷。
summary_zh: 世界模型中的长程失效通常被归因于累积误差，这种笼统的描述并未区分何种误差在累积。我们提出一种运动学与动力学的重新框架：世界模型倾向于以运动学而非动力学的方式进行想象。我们将此操作化为所设想的运动学一致性误差（iKCE），这是一种逐步骤诊断指标，用于衡量推演过程偏离闭式运动学零点的程度，并辅以扰动协议，该协议测试当物理条件跨越状态边界时iKCE是否产生响应。我们在已发布的DreamerV3检查点上实例化了该诊断指标，该模型基于DMC walker-walk环境训练，其中想象推演的iKCE数值大约比匹配的真实物理推演高出两个数量级。在跨越步态崩溃边界的摩擦系数扫描过程中，即使经过训练的策略奖励在同一范围内崩溃，模型的iKCE在统计上仍保持平稳，从而呈现出运动学而非动力学的特征。该诊断指标能够在超过体现体步态周期的时间跨度上，区分运动学想象与动力学想象。

title: GraspIT: A Dataset Bridging the Sim-to-Real gap and back for Validated Grasping SE(3) Pose Generation
summary: Robust robotic grasping of novel objects requires datasets that simultaneously provide photorealistic RGB-D observations, physically validated grasp quality annotations, and a principled bridge between simulation and the real world, which existing datasets lack to provide jointly. \textbf{GraspIT} addresses this gap: tabletop scenes in NVIDIA Isaac Sim are annotated via a four-stage physical slip-test on parallel Franka Panda instances, producing trajectory-reachability checks and continuous quality scores beyond force-closure.Of ${\sim}$2.3M candidates, 83% pass as \emph{good} ($s{\geq}0.50$); the 17% that passed force-closure but failed the slip-test provide graded hard negatives. A Real$\leftrightarrow$Sim loop back-projects these labels onto 100 real-world scenes. The release provides ${\sim}$316k annotated RGBD frame sets across 1035 sim and 100 real scenes, with instance masks, 6-DoF poses, physical object properties, and scored 6-DoF grasps. All tools are open-source and Docker-containerized. The trajectory planning within Isaac Sim further allows streaming of high resolution demonstrations for tabletop manipulation policy learning and behavior cloning.
tldr: GraspIT provides a large-scale dataset with physically validated grasp quality annotations via slip-testing in simulation and a real-to-sim loop, bridging sim and real for SE(3) grasp pose generation.
tldr_zh: GraspIT通过仿真中的滑移测试和真实-仿真循环，提供了大规模数据集，包含物理验证的抓取质量标注，弥合了仿真与真实之间的差距，用于SE(3)抓取姿态生成。
summary_zh: 鲁棒的新颖物体抓取需要数据集同时提供真实感的RGB-D观测、经过物理验证的抓取质量标注，以及连接仿真与真实世界的原理性桥梁——现有数据集无法同时满足这些要求。**GraspIT**填补了这一空白：在NVIDIA Isaac Sim中，通过四阶段物理滑移测试对桌面场景的平行Franka Panda机械臂实例进行标注，生成轨迹可达性检查结果和超越力闭合条件的连续质量评分。在约230万个候选抓取中，83%被判定为“良好”（$s{\geq}0.50$）；通过力闭合测试但未通过滑移测试的17%则提供了分级硬负样本。通过真实↔仿真循环回路，这些标签被反向映射至100个真实场景。该数据集包含1035个仿真场景与100个真实场景的约31.6万组带标注RGB-D帧数据，并提供实例掩码、六自由度位姿、物理对象属性及带评分的六自由度抓取标注。所有工具均为开源并已容器化部署于Docker。此外，Isaac Sim中的轨迹规划功能可流式输出高分辨率演示数据，用于桌面操作策略学习与行为克隆。

title: IMR: Iterative Mode-World Weighted Regression for Multi-Agent Trajectory Prediction
summary: Multi-agent motion prediction is essential for automated vehicles to understand the intentions of surrounding vehicles. However, previous prediction-based and anchor-based methods have limitations in mode diversity and prediction accuracy, respectively. These limitations may cause inadequate safety assessments and behavioral deviations in automated vehicles. To address this issue, a mode-world weighted regression loss is proposed to bridge the gap between these features. Specifically, this approach mitigates mode collapse while simultaneously improving world ranking and top-1 confidence. Furthermore, the proposed iterative decoder improves prediction accuracy by recurrently and segmentally generating trajectories. Experimental results show the proposed method ranks first in the Argoverse 2 multi-agent motion forecasting benchmark against other methods.
tldr: This paper proposes a mode-world weighted regression loss and an iterative decoder for multi-agent trajectory prediction in autonomous driving, achieving state-of-the-art results on the Argoverse 2 benchmark.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种模态-世界加权回归损失和迭代解码器，用于自动驾驶中的多智能体轨迹预测，在Argoverse 2基准上取得了最先进的结果。
summary_zh: 多智能体运动预测对于自动驾驶车辆理解周围车辆意图至关重要。然而，以往的基于轨迹模式和基于锚点的方法分别在模式多样性和预测精度方面存在局限性。这些局限性可能导致自动驾驶车辆的安全评估不足及行为偏差。为解决该问题，本文提出了一种模式加权回归损失函数，以弥合上述特征之间的差距。具体而言，该方法在缓解模式坍塌的同时，提升了模式排名及最高置信度。此外，所提出的迭代解码器通过循环分段生成轨迹，提高了预测精度。实验结果表明，在Argoverse 2多智能体运动预测基准测试中，该方法与其他方法相比排名第一。

title: Efficient Transfer Learning of Robot Dynamic Models Using Morphological Similarity
summary: This study proposes a neural network-based transfer learning framework for modeling the dynamics of soft, fin-actuated underwater robots. We focus on morphologically similar robots that differ in scale and hydrodynamic properties. A model trained on data from a larger robot (source domain) is adapted to a smaller one (target domain) with limited labeled data. To enable label-efficient transfer, we develop an autoencoder-based domain adaptation approach that learns a shared latent representation aligning the dynamics of both robots. Experiments on two real underwater robots show that the proposed method enables accurate state estimation of the body-frame velocities on a target platform without labeled data, highlighting its potential for efficient cross-robot dynamics transfer among morphologically similar platforms.
tldr: Proposes an autoencoder-based transfer learning framework for dynamics modeling of soft, fin-actuated underwater robots, enabling label-efficient cross-robot state estimation using morphological similarity.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种基于自动编码器的迁移学习框架，用于建模软体鳍驱动水下机器人的动力学，利用形态相似性实现跨机器人的标签高效状态估计。
summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种基于神经网络的迁移学习框架，用于对软体鳍驱动水下机器人的动力学进行建模。我们聚焦于形态相似但尺度与流体动力学特性不同的机器人。基于较大机器人（源域）数据训练的模型，被迁移至标注数据有限的较小机器人（目标域）。为实现标签高效的迁移，我们开发了一种基于自编码器的域自适应方法，通过学习共享潜在表征来对齐两类机器人的动力学特性。在两种真实水下机器人上开展的实验表明，所提方法能够在无标注数据条件下实现对目标平台本体坐标系速度的准确状态估计，凸显了其在形态相似平台间实现高效跨机器人动力学迁移的潜力。

title: Physics-Regularized Machine Learning for Proprioceptive Vehicle Localization Using Onboard Sensors
summary: Accurate and robust localization is essential for autonomous mobility systems in real-world environments.
